verdict.rationale: Mastra is itself a first-party TypeScript framework/library that developers code against directly. You import tools, pass them to agent constructors, and embed agents and workflows into React, Next.js and Node.js apps. Hands-on users corroborate building with it and call it best in class for TypeScript. missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond TypeScript (e.g. Python), a documented client SDK for calling a deployed Mastra server, and a published API/SDK reference (OpenAPI probes returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Mastra is a framework for building AI-powered applications and agents with a modern TypeScript stack.
Add a tool to an agent by importing the tool and passing it to the agent constructor as a tools object.
Mastra bundles agents and workflows directly into existing React, Next.js and Node.js apps, or ships them as standalone endpoints.
After three months with Mastra, a user called it awesome and best in class for TypeScript.
